signals.title: MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3.0): open-weight omni-modal model, 2K video with native stereo audio in one pass
signals.summary: MiniMax launched H3 on July 31: reads text/images/video/audio as one context, outputs 4-15s clips at 2K/24fps with native stereo audio (no separate audio stage, no upscaler). Takes up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos, 3 reference audio clips per generation. Live via API and fal.ai today; open weights promised within days under a community license (commercial free under $20M revenue).
signals.run_with_it_note: Hit the fal.ai H3 endpoint this week. Feed it real DCKT/NKST tour footage as the 3 reference videos plus branded stills as reference images, generate one 15s branded clip with native audio in a single pass. The reference-image consistency is the new part: it replaces his stitch-Seedance-then-add-ElevenLabs chain with one call, and the operator advantage is he has the real footage a software founder does not.

signals.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731: open-weight, #3/101 intelligence at $0.14/$0.28 per M tokens
signals.summary: Open-weights reasoning model (284B total / 13B active MoE, 1M context) released July 31. Intelligence Index 50, ranked #3 of 101, well above frontier median, at $0.14 in / $0.28 out per M tokens and 122.7 tok/sec. Cache hits are $0.003/M (98% off). 585 pts on HN, corroborated by Artificial Analysis and the TLDR price-war thread.
signals.run_with_it_note: Swap it in as the brain behind a Twilio SMS/voice loop for one business (NPB after-hours booking line) via an open-weight host (Fireworks, Together, Telnyx). Frontier-near quality, owned weights, no vendor lock, and at $0.14/$0.28 an always-on line for all 12 businesses is pennies. Cheaper and higher-ranked than last week's Kimi-K3 pick.

signals.title: Qwen3.8-Max: a new bar for coding and cowork
signals.summary: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max hit HN front page today (733 pts, #2) as a step up for coding and agentic 'cowork.' Detail thin: the blog and X post would not load this run, so open-weight status and exact pricing are unverified. Momentum is real; ownability is the open question.
signals.run_with_it_note: Point it at one real automation job in his Claude Code / agent ops workflow via the Qwen API and compare against his current model on a booking-sheet or reply-drafting task. Cheap to A/B. Treat as provisional until open-weight status is confirmed; the Qwen line has open-weight siblings he can self-host if Max stays API-only.

signals.title: TurboFieldfare: Gemma 4 26B running in ~2 GB RAM on Apple Silicon
signals.summary: Apache-2.0 Swift+Metal runtime runs a 26B model in about 2 GB of RAM on a Mac, with a native app, CLI, and OpenAI-compatible server. 912 pts on HN. Genuine step change for local inference, but requires Apple Silicon + macOS 26 + Metal 4.
signals.run_with_it_note: Out-scores Qwen3.8-Max on raw weighted total, but David's 2015 Intel Mac (and the Intel loop box) cannot run it, so run-with-it fails and it stays a Watch. Becomes an owned-land Spark the day he moves to an Apple Silicon machine.

signals.title: xAI Grok Voice Agent Builder (no-code phone agents)
signals.summary: No-code builder deploys a production phone agent in ~2 min, sub-second latency, SIP into existing numbers, ~$0.06/min. Highest raw weighted score in the set, but >14 days old with no fresh threshold-cross, so it stays a Watch per the age rule. The fresh development is the cheap open brain to run behind it (see DeepSeek V4 Flash).
signals.run_with_it_note: Point it at a spare Twilio DID, feed one business FAQ, let it answer the after-hours booking line. Carried from 2026-07-26; still the best owned desk-to-mobile move.

signals.title: movie-gen: open MIT pipeline for 5-12 min AI films (Seedance 2.0 + Higgsfield CLI)
signals.summary: MIT pipeline chains Seedance video, Nano Banana Pro images, ElevenLabs voice, Gemini QC through Higgsfield's CLI, orchestrated by Claude Code. Aging past 14 days; the content-engine thread is refreshed this week by MiniMax H3.
signals.run_with_it_note: Still clonable for multi-shot branded films; pair it with MiniMax H3 for the shots that need native audio in one pass. Carried from 2026-07-27.

signals.title: Kimi-K3 open weights (2.8T params, Apache 2.0)
signals.summary: First ~3T-param open-weight frontier model, Apache 2.0, Fable-competitive. Still strong, but for the cheap owned-brain job it is now undercut by DeepSeek V4 Flash ($0.14/$0.28, #3/101). Corroborated this week by Kimi K3 landing on Telnyx Inference and rest-of-world coverage of the free release.
signals.run_with_it_note: Fine as a bigger owned brain when quality matters more than cost; default to DeepSeek V4 Flash for always-on loops. Carried from 2026-07-27.

signals.title: Cactus Hybrid: on-device model that knows when it's wrong
signals.summary: Confidence probes keep 45-85% of queries on a small local model, escalating only hard ones to cloud. Part of a real convergence this week (with TurboFieldfare and the WASTE engine) toward frontier-quality local inference on consumer hardware.
signals.run_with_it_note: Same hardware caveat as the rest of the local stack: best once he is on Apple Silicon. Carried from 2026-07-26.

signals.title: The Only Moat That Survives AI: proprietary data + expert decisions
signals.summary: Thesis from TLDR Founders: as models improve, routing and features depreciate while proprietary data and expert decision-making compound. Framing, not a tool, but it maps exactly onto David's 76k customer contacts and 12-business operator knowledge.
signals.run_with_it_note: The concrete move: start structuring booking history + guide knowledge into one proprietary dataset an AI product can sit on. High fit, low newly-possible, so a Watch not a Spark.

signals.title: Yap: OSS on-device voice dictation for macOS, no model to download
signals.summary: Open-source local dictation using the built-in on-device speech stack, nothing to download. 104 pts on HN. Owned and private, but desktop-bound and likely needs a newer macOS.

signals.title: WASTE inference engine: run models larger than memory (Kimi K3 on a MacBook)
signals.summary: Engine that runs models bigger than available RAM, initially Kimi K3 on a 64 GB MacBook Pro. Another data point in the frontier-goes-local convergence, but still needs high-end Apple Silicon.

signals.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 prices (80% on Luna, 20% on Terra)
signals.summary: OpenAI slashed pricing 80% on Luna and 20% on Terra and boosted Sol API performance. Part of a broad frontier price war (see Contrary's piece). Rented land, so a backdrop signal not a build target.

signals.title: Open-weight LLMs have caught up on accuracy at 1/3 the cost
signals.summary: Analysis: open models now match closed-source accuracy on regulatory-style tasks at a third of the cost, with different error profiles favoring task-specific selection. Reinforces the owned-brain thesis behind the DeepSeek Spark.

signals.title: The Frontier AI Price Wars Continue (Contrary Research)
signals.summary: Major labs are cutting prices fast, pushing startups to minimize switching costs. Context for why owned open weights beat vendor lock-in right now.

signals.title: Inkling-Small: Thinking Machines' 276B MoE (12B active), 1M context
signals.summary: Efficient MoE with multimodal reasoning and 1M-token context at reduced compute. Likely API-first (ownability unverified), so logged rather than actioned.

signals.title: Tokenless (YC S26): automatic model switching to save money
signals.summary: Auto-routes each call to the cheapest capable model as prices fall. Same week, Manifest published that it deprecated its own LLM router after 4 months, so the durability of routing-as-a-product is in question. A rented layer for David.

signals.title: QM (YC): open-source multiplayer agent platform
signals.summary: YC-backed agent platform with isolated per-user workspaces, shareable skills, internal knowledge search, and project tracking. Interesting for a multi-manager org, but a product to adopt rather than ground to own.

signals.title: MiniMax H3 hosted on fal.ai (developer endpoint)
signals.summary: Dedupe pointer: fal.ai hosts H3 as a developer endpoint, the cheap-test entry for the H3 Spark. Logged so the H3 signal keeps one identity across sources.

signals.title: Faint signal: frontier inference is going local on consumer Macs
signals.summary: Three separate same-week launches (TurboFieldfare running 26B in 2GB, the WASTE oversized-model engine, Cactus Hybrid confidence routing) point the same direction: frontier-grade models running fully local on a laptop. Faint, hardware-gated, but converging.

signals.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 price/perf analysis (HN front page)
signals.summary: Dedupe pointer: the 585-pt HN discussion corroborating the DeepSeek V4 Flash Spark. Kept as a momentum corroboration, one identity with the Artificial Analysis entry.
